messages.subject: Plots of time varying covariates
parts:
Hi,

I am learning INLA. I have a spatiotemporal model where age-group and poverty-proportion are covariates. Now I would like to plot/visualise
                 1. How poverty-proprtion in each area varies with time
                 2. How the relative risk varies in time for each age group 
I do not know how to go about this. Find below the formula and summary results of the model. Thank you in advance.

formula <- Cases ~ f(Agegroup, model = "iid") + f(PovertyProportion, model = "iid") +
                   f(areaID, model = "besag", graph="MalawiGraph.txt", param=c(1,0.01)) +                               f(area1ID, model = "iid") +              
                   f(time1ID, model = "rw2") + f(timeID, model = "iid") +
                   f(STinteractionIndex, model = "iid")
res6 <- inla(formula,family = "poisson", data = data, E = ExpectedCases,
            control.compute=list(dic=TRUE,cpo=TRUE,waic=TRUE))  
summary(res6)
